Arguably the worst course I have taken at Bilkent.  There was multiple questions on both UNIVERSITY examinations, midterm and final, up to 50 points! AND THEY WERE DIRECTLY TAKEN FROM QUIZLET.

YOU DO NOT LEARN ANYTHING AT ALL FROM THIS COURSE. The remaining questions other than the multiple choice questions were calculating THE SAME financial ratios OVER AND OVER AGAIN. And the ratios were given at the back of the exam. So if you are intelligent enough to read what ratio is asked, look behind the paper and plug numbers into a calculator you are top level financial statement analyst according to this course...

 Is this what financial statement analysis is? Calculating ratios with our calculator with no understanding or intuition whatsoever. I was hoping to comment on maybe not precise but possible meanings of these ratios when they come together or I wish we at least looked at some real life examples of how actions of firms reflect upon their financials (and ratios), and how they are priced by the financial markets. THAT would have made an amazing course but unfortunately we were VERY far away from it.
